name: miaplacidus
description: MIAPLACIDUS browser game remake of Cosmic Forge

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode production
scripts.build:demo: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode demo
scripts.format: oxfmt --write src tests playwright.config.ts index.html vite.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check src tests playwright.config.ts index.html vite.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json
